{{Top|leg}}
'''Marker Rings''' were [[Ring/Legends|rings]] worn by [[Noble/Legends|Nobles]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kilia IV/Legends|Kilia IV]]. Each one bore the heraldry of the noble's particular house, along with a tiny transmitter and receiver. When two marker rings from the same house would come in close contact, the transmitters would recognize each other and cause the rings to glow.

[[Kilian Rangers/Legends|Kilian Rangers]] who were also nobles would have a chevron denoting their rank as Rangers emblazoned on the ring as well. A bronze chevron indicated a Squire, a silver chevron identified a Ranger, and a gold chevron denoted a Kilian Lord. Also, many Kilian Rangers with marker rings would often turn them into [[The Force/Legends|Force]] Talismans.
